name: bean_container_missing
description: v6.24 bean container (work_sta word 33 bit 8, stock lackBeenTank.png): bit 8 clear with a live link and word 0 = 1 / word 1 = 0 is the BEAN phase (amber MISSING / MANGLER chip, HOME subline 'BEAN CONTAINER MISSING · FIT IT' / 'BØNNEBEHOLDER MANGLER · SÆT DEN I'), NOT sleep; word 0 = 0 (power off, the MCU sleep task) still wins as SLEEP — word 1 = 1 priority is covered by the UI selftest, the UI's keep-awake writes word 1 = 0 here; putting the container back (bit 8 set) returns READY. Nothing is written (no frame outside the polls and the keep-awake) the whole time.
